title: 12 Best Sushi in Tokyo
description: Explore the 12 best sushi restaurants in Tokyo for 2026. From Michelin-starred omakase to bustling conveyor belts, discover top picks for every budget and experience, with insider tips.

places.name: Sukiyabashi Jiro Honten
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase menu (chef's selection) is the only option, featuring about 20 meticulously prepared pieces of nigiri.

places.name: Sushi Saito
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Omakase, featuring seasonal Edo-style nigiri and a few exceptional tsumami (appetizers).

places.name: Sushi Sawada
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Omakase menu is seasonal and expertly curated, showcasing the best ingredients available that day.

places.name: Sushi Sho Masa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The chef's omakase, which rotates frequently, is designed to be a journey through textures and tastes, often featuring expertly aged fish.

places.name: Sushi no Midori Ginza
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Chef's Assortment' (Omakase-Nigiri) offers a great variety, or try the 'Super Anago' (sea eel) nigiri for a unique treat.

places.name: Katsumidori Seibu Shibuya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their specialty rolls, unique toppings, and seasonal fish. The 'Negitoro' (minced fatty tuna) roll is a crowd favorite.

places.name: Sushi Dai
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Omakase Set' is highly recommended, featuring a chef's selection of 10-12 pieces of the freshest fish of the day, plus one piece of your choice.

places.name: Uogashi Nihon-ichi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order individual pieces (nigiri) of your favorite fish. Don't miss the salmon, tuna, or seasonal specials.

places.name: Genki Sushi Shibuya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Experiment with various nigiri, gunkan (seaweed-wrapped sushi), and their famous rolls like the 'Spicy Tuna Roll'.

places.name: Midorisushi Akasaka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous 'Tokujo Nigiri Set' (Special Premium Nigiri Set) is an excellent value, packed with fresh, delicious pieces.

places.name: Sushitomi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for the daily specials (kyō no osusume) or opt for a nigiri set. The sea urchin (uni) and fatty tuna (otoro) are consistently excellent.

places.name: Ganso Zushi (元祖寿司)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab plates off the belt or order individual nigiri. Their salmon and various tuna cuts are reliable choices.
